source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: BACKSHIFT identifies its covariance-difference system iff intervention-variance profiles meet condition (13); Corollary 2 states that this condition cannot hold with two environments and is generically met with at least three.

GnIES uses full Gaussian environment distributions with invariant B and environment-varying diagonal noise covariance, characterizes its distributional equivalence class, and gives a greedy recovery procedure for unknown targets.
The paper proves recovery of a linear Gaussian DAG and its coefficients from one full joint distribution under jointly independent equal-variance errors.
Theorem 4.2 supplies uniform concentration for the sine-transformed Kendall estimator; Theorem 4.3 transfers rank-correlation input to undirected precision-graph procedures.
